method: in-process UI actions and real FLTK framebuffer, no native OS input
scenario: three roots: 16MiB file, directory with10000 small files, symlink; queue, pause, cancellation, no-clobber, normal close

active_cancel_after_progress.scope: directory copying after observed per-file progress; auto strategy may clone data, not necessarily userspace transfer

stable_scope: post-copy/no-clobber window after loaded listing, not universal idle

terminal_exit_observations.completeness_scope: complete verifies surviving readable identities, not full lifetimes; confirmed exits with unread memory are explicit; sampled peaks are lower bounds

sample_at_memory_max.completeness_scope: complete verifies surviving readable identities, not full lifetimes; confirmed exits with unread memory are explicit; sampled peaks are lower bounds

metrics.completeness_scope: complete verifies surviving readable identities, not lifetime coverage; confirmed exits can have unavailable memory
metrics.peak_scope: sampled lower bound; not an exact peak; GPU memory excluded
metrics.snapshot_scope: process reads are not simultaneous; CPU omits first/new and final/exited intervals

resource_scope: sampled complete observed tree PSS+SwapPss; not lifetime peak, GPU excluded; explicit scenario, goal50MB decimal/ceiling150MB
